The Fluke FEV350 EV Charging Station Analyzer is designed to help technicians streamline EV charger testing with smarter workflows and automated processes.


In this short video, discover key capabilities that help reduce setup time, improve efficiency, and simplify testing in the field.


**Featured capabilities:**


• Bi-directional communication with TruTest™ software
• Direct transfer of test plans from TruTest to the FEV350
• Expert Mode for experienced technicians who want a streamlined workflow
• Auto Sequence for one-button execution of complete test procedures
• Expanded compatibility across electrical systems and regional requirements
• Reduced manual data entry and fewer opportunities for error


Whether you're commissioning, inspecting, or maintaining EV charging infrastructure, the FEV350 helps simplify the testing process from start to finish.
